neighbours.label: a point in a clause where a contrast ('but' / 'however') is likely to follow
fire: The country wants more nuclear plants to increase its renewable energy, but critics disagree.
Renno points out that this is unlikely, but the theory persists.
Some families later returned to their homes, but many never did.
The hotel was cheap and close to the beach, but the rooms were tiny.
I bought a truck years ago and never looked back, but my wife did.
The ability to walk again is crucial, but recovery takes years.
The recipe looks simple at first, but the timing is tricky.
He tried hard to save money without help, but rent kept rising.
quiet: The country wants more wind farms to increase its energy supply and cut costs.
Renno points out that this is likely because the ice was thick.
Some families later returned to their homes and rebuilt their gardens.
The hotel was cheap and close to the beach and the old harbor.
I bought a truck years ago and drove it across the whole country.
The ability to walk again came after months of daily therapy.
The recipe uses flour, eggs, sugar and a little butter.
He saved money every month and bought a small flat in town.
